name: Marcus
role: Boss. Runs the team; the person you ask, confess to and push back on.
look: a man in his late fifties with thick silver-grey hair swept back and up from the forehead, a short neatly trimmed grey-white beard and moustache, heavy grey eyebrows that sit low and furrowed, deep-set grey-brown eyes with crow's feet, a strong straight nose, weathered lightly tanned skin with deep forehead creases. He wears a charcoal-grey pinstripe three-piece suit (jacket and waistcoat), a crisp white shirt and a dark navy tie. Broad shoulders, upright posture.
personality: Busy, blunt and short on patience; always has a client meeting in five minutes. Respects people who get to the point, own their mistakes and bring a plan. Hates surprises more than mistakes. Softens when he hears a real reason and sees the work is covered.

voice.note: Existing Leave lines are this voice. Look the id up with --list-voices, test eleven_v4 against v-poor-b3/b5, then lock settings here.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view, turned to his right (our left), neutral busy expression.
sheet.prompt: Marcus in a three-quarter view, head and body turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes looking slightly past the camera. Neutral, busy expression: brows level, mouth closed in a flat line. Same framing and lighting as the calm meter face.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view, turned to our right, neutral busy expression.
sheet.prompt: Marcus in a three-quarter view, head and body turned about 35 degrees to our right, eyes looking slightly past the camera. Neutral, busy expression: brows level, mouth closed in a flat line. Same framing and lighting as the calm meter face.

sheet.summary: Side profile facing left, reading something below frame.
sheet.prompt: Marcus in a clean side profile facing our left, chin slightly lowered as if reading something below the frame. Calm, focused expression, mouth closed. Only head, neck and shoulders are visible.

sheet.summary: Mood face: quietly disappointed (Saying no: "go on, I'll just do it myself").
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, quietly disappointed: brows raised slightly in the middle, eyelids a little lowered, mouth closed and pulled flat to one side, head tilted a few degrees. Not angry, just let down.

sheet.summary: Mood face: relieved, the tension leaves his face.
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, relieved: brows relaxed and lifted, eyes softened, a small closed-mouth half smile, shoulders dropped a little. The tension has visibly left his face.

sheet.summary: Mood face: steely and controlled (Confessing, after the reveal).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, steely and controlled: jaw set, brows low and level, eyes steady and direct, mouth closed in a firm straight line. Serious but not shouting.
Marcus facing the camera, caught off guard: brows lifted high, eyes wide, mouth closed or only slightly parted, head pulled back a touch.

sheet.summary: Mood face: tired sigh, eyes closed (start frame for a sigh clip).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera mid-sigh: eyes closed, brows drawn up in the middle, cheeks slightly puffed, lips closed, shoulders dropped. Weary, not angry.

sheet.summary: Looks down at a phone held below frame (Confessing: the CFO email).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera with his head tipped down, eyes looking down at a phone held below the bottom of the frame (the phone and his hands are NOT visible). A faint cool screen glow lights his chin. Brows starting to knit.
